text: Read-only early review of live Opus patch at 22:22Z, not immutable-candidate verdict: Dispatch.mustFinish infers unfinished jobs from dataset < highest completed index; misses interrupted jobs at the same highest index and any dispatched above it (two cells complete 0..14, C0/15 complete, C1/15 in flight at crash). Need durable dispatch/pending state to honor finish-in-flight after soft stop. runWave catches ExecutionException only, finally shutdown + interruptible awaitTermination(1 minute) ignoring false; caller interruption can throw with live workers. Require deterministic-latch caller-interruption regression and termination join restoring interrupt only after every worker stops. Sent to active owner via Fray 168/169; no overlapping edits.
